F2.root_cause: A species record with no database id (idx 134: unresolved Mus musculus, mapping_meta.resolution.status=unresolved) takes the next value of the shared IdFactory counter. At the species stage the counter is at 1, which equals Homo sapiens' PathBank id 1, so both species were written with id 1. PathWhiz keys the species hash by id (lib/pwml_parser.rb store_object), so the later record overwrote the earlier.
F2.fix: writer.py: collect the database ids of all species records first; a species without one takes counter values until it finds one not in that set. Output is unchanged wherever there was no collision.
